content.title: Ansar Special Live Webinar-03: ‘How to Read Seerah?’
content.subtitle: The right approach to studying Seerah and a roadmap to embodying the Prophetic model.
content.body:
When we hear the name of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ, our eyes fill with tears, and our hearts yearn for a sense of profound refuge. We buy books on Seerah and place them on our reading tables, feel shaken by the history of Badr and Uhud, and shed tears remembering the wounded feet of the Prophet ﷺ in Ta’if. But have we ever asked ourselves—has all this reading remained merely a collection of historical events? Why has the Prophetic life, which was the very breath of the Ummah, failed to reflect in our everyday behavior, family, and professional lives?

Not Dry Pages of History, but a Living Guide for Life

Seerah is not merely an ancient story of heroism; it is a guiding light for a believer lost in the darkness of life. As we turn each page, we should ask—why did the Messenger of Allah ﷺ make that decision? What was behind his humility on the day of victory, and how did he respond with forgiveness even in the face of betrayal? The purpose of studying Seerah is not simply to memorize events, but to use the Prophetic model to transform and improve ourselves.

Reflecting Prophetic Light in Our Personal, Family, and Professional Lives

From tensions at home to difficult decisions at work, the Messenger of Allah ﷺ remains an unparalleled example. We need to understand how the lessons of Seerah can be connected with our personal worship, family relationships, and professional lives. We also need to learn how to make Seerah a regular part of our routine and carry its lessons into every step of our lives.

A Special Journey of Light with the Ansar Family

For the brothers and sisters of the Muslims Day Ansar family, this special session will feature Kabir Anwar (BSc, BUET; MBA, Malaysia; BAIS, IOU). His insights into connecting modern management with Prophetic Seerah will, In Sha Allah, offer us a new perspective on studying Seerah.

When and How Can You Join?

  • Date: 26 September 2026 (Sunday)

  • Time: 9:00 PM to 10:15 PM

  • How to Join: Ansar members can join directly via Zoom. The session will also be livestreamed publicly on the official Muslims Day Facebook page.

Send Your Questions to the Speaker

Do you have questions about studying Seerah, applying its lessons in real life, or any particular doubt related to Seerah? Fill out the Google Form below and send us your question. Selected questions will be answered during the live session.

👉 Submit your question here: https://forms.gle/nAUogYwP5CT4gYyb8

Let us embrace Seerah not merely within the pages of a book, but within our lives. On that blessed evening, will you join us with the thirst of your heart?
